basic_details.job_title: IIT Gandhinagar Senior Research Fellow (Computer science and engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: IIT Gandhinagar Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) for 1 Senior Research Fellow (SRF) vacancy in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering. Candidates with M.Tech., M.S. or M.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering or a related discipline, along with NET/GATE qualification and at least 2 years of research experience, can apply online.

qualification.details: Exposure to methodologies for dataset validation, error analysis, and annotation quality assessment. Ability to design reproducible experiments, perform error analysis, and report results with proper metrics. Prior experience in Python platforms such as NLTK, Anaconda, and Jupyter/Python notebooks along with basic versioning system (Git & Github) knowledge. Familiarity with web development technologies, including HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and jQuery, along with backend and deployment technologies such as Flask, Nginx, MongoDB, SQL, ElasticSearch, or similar frameworks. Demonstrated ability to write efficient, clean, and well-documented Python code. Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Experience in the implementation of at least one ML/NLP-based project, preferably involving real-world datasets. Experience in conducting research and publishing papers in peer-reviewed conferences and/or journals. Ability to read, understand, and implement research ideas from academic literature, and to conduct systematic experiments and analysis. Good communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research-oriented environment.

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/.
Complete the online application form for the Senior Research Fellow position under Advertisement No. SPON/10456/Advt0346 before the last date.

content_sections.text: Exposure to methodologies for dataset validation, error analysis, and annotation quality assessment. Prior experience in Python platforms such as NLTK, Anaconda, and Jupyter/Python notebooks along with basic versioning system (Git & Github) knowledge. Familiarity with web development technologies, including HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and jQuery, along with backend and deployment technologies such as Flask, Nginx, MongoDB, SQL, ElasticSearch, or similar frameworks. Demonstrated ability to write efficient, clean, and well-documented Python code. Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Experience in the implementation of at least one ML/NLP-based project, preferably involving real-world datasets. Experience in conducting research and publishing papers in peer-reviewed conferences and/or journals. Ability to read, understand, and implement research ideas from academic literature, and to conduct systematic experiments and analysis. Good communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research-oriented environment.

rows.essential_qualification_required: 1. M.Tech./M.S/M.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering or equivalent degree in a closely related discipline with a minimum of 60% marks or 7.0 CGPA (on a 10-point scale). 2. National Eligibility Tests- CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE. 3. Minimum two years of research experience after obtaining the qualifying degree, as per institute norms. Academic qualification requires a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 54,600/- along with a House Rent Allowance of Rs. 12,600/- per month, applicable as per institute norms. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting or appointment, and a higher cutoff level may be used. The institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test or not to fill up the position.

faq.question: Q1. Is this Senior Research Fellow post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is a temporary appointment for 12 months, which may be extended based on satisfactory performance and the availability of funds under the ANRF sponsored project.

faq.question: Q2. Are allowances paid in addition to the base fellowship amount?
faq.answer: Yes, the selected candidate receives a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 54,600/- along with a House Rent Allowance of Rs. 12,600/- per month as per institute norms.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualification requirements for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Tech., M.S, or M.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering or a closely related discipline with at least 60% marks (or 7.0 CGPA), possess valid CSIR-UGC NET or GATE qualification, and have a minimum of two years of research experience after obtaining the qualifying degree.
